source.source_title: Technical Data Sheet Concerning the Commission Delegated Regulations (EU) No 811/2013 and (EU) No 813/2013 — Aerona HPR290i160
source.verification_notes: The official model-specific Grant technical datasheet, current Grant product page, Grant family technical datasheet, matching Heat Pump KEYMARK subtype page and certificate were opened and transcribed. Product identity, registration number and model-specific Ecodesign values were checked across sources. Manufacturer publications disagree on some SCOP, depth and weight values/definitions; these have been preserved separately and no normalized specifications have been created. The exact product code also appears in the SEAI Triple E product listing (HPU117632); this is kept distinct from HARP and domestic grant eligibility.

extraction.note: First-pass V2 archival record. Manufacturer and Heat Pump KEYMARK source sections are preserved in Markdown and linked individually below. No normalized specifications have been added; this avoids prematurely defining category-wide field names and preserves unresolved differences between manufacturer publications. The SEAI Triple E listing is retained as a separate scheme-specific source; it is not treated as HARP or domestic grant approval.

sections.heading: Grant manufacturer technical data sheet — product identification and medium-temperature (55°C) data

sections.heading: SEAI Triple E register — scheme context
sections.source_text: SEAI describes the Triple E Register as a searchable list of energy-efficient products that meet minimum energy-efficiency criteria and are typically best-in-class. SEAI states that businesses selecting listed equipment can use the Accelerated Capital Allowance (ACA) tax incentive. SEAI separately identifies HARP as the product-efficiency database for home-heating appliances. The Triple E listing is therefore not treated as proof of HARP listing or domestic SEAI heat-pump grant approval.

record_notes: This is an archival-first-pass record. No normalized_specifications have been populated; category-wide heat-pump field names and unit conventions should be agreed through the V2 collection process before normalization.
The model-specific Grant technical datasheet and the matching KEYMARK record agree on low- and medium-temperature rated heat output and seasonal space-heating energy efficiency, subject to rounding.
The current Grant product page reports 419 mm depth, while the Grant family technical-data sheet reports 425 mm for HPR290i160.

The current Grant product page reports weight 182/210 kg; the family technical-data sheet reports empty/full weight 180/184 kg. These labels are not equivalent definitions and must not be reconciled by assumption.

SCOP values differ across the current Grant product page (4.59 at 35°C), Grant family technical-data sheet (4.50 at 35°C and 3.29 at 55°C) and KEYMARK subtype record (4.63 low temperature and 3.4 medium temperature). Do not normalize these as interchangeable values.
The KEYMARK database displays refrigerant mass as “1,650 kg”; the Grant family technical-data sheet states 1.65 kg. The displayed KEYMARK punctuation is preserved and not independently interpreted.

The manufacturer datasheet marks “Heat Pump Combination Heater: No” while also listing DHW data on the medium-temperature page. The KEYMARK record lists Heating + DHW + low temp. These statements are preserved separately; their exact system/configuration relationship is not inferred.

SEAI Triple E lists this exact product code as HPU117632, valid from 09/04/2025, with CoP 4.72. SEAI describes Triple E as a separate energy-efficient-products register associated with the business Accelerated Capital Allowance scheme; SEAI separately describes HARP as the home-heating product-efficiency database. Do not interpret Triple E listing as HARP listing or domestic SEAI grant approval. The Triple E row does not state CoP test conditions.
